additional_info.subject: 0415531 - ID0415498-DC/Si-D/IT-[Multiple] Update firmware ( C1) CRM:00314000156
additional_info.body:
Buon pomeriggio Riccardo,
I am reaching out regarding ticket
ID0415531
, which was opened for issues in rolling out FW 6.1.3 to a list of chargers from Rome.
The issue in rolling out the FW was related to the missing hawkbit.conf file on the charger (which includes the connection parameters to hawkbit). The hawkbit.conf has been generated for all chargers in the list. This problem can happen e.g. if a CFast card is flashed and an old charger config is copied to the CFast card or sometimes if a charger was newly commissioned and it was missing this file.
The chargers in the list you provided us are all running on v6.1.3 now. Charger MP/T1 170004362 had a very low signal, and the rollout of the FW took a very long time. It is now available to be updated at your earliest convenience.
As the issue is solved, I will proceed to close this ticket.
W
